Name: Looking for Love Anthro Characters Continued patch
Author: OokamiKasuke
Description:
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21370]Looking For Love Redux[/url] mod over writes the sprites and portraits of the NPCs it modifies to make date-able. This patch will overwrite the images in LFL to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] mod.[/size]

[b][size=4]Install:[/size][/b]
- Looking for love and Anthro Charactes Continued should be installed first along with all their required mods.
- Download one of the zip files depending on other mods you use. Unzip the folder and copy the "[CP] Looking for Love" folder into your "Stardew Valley\Mods\" folder. This should ask you to overwrite some files if done right.

[size=4]"Looking for Love ACC patch.zip"[/size]: Replaces the "vanilla" sprite and portrait options with Anthro versions.
[size=4]"Looking for Love ACC patch wMarcus Bull.zip"[/size]: same as above but changes Marnie to Marcus for use with my [url=https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/22311-sdv-undares-prostitution-anthro-characters-continued-patch/]Devious Valley patch[/url] on LoversLab.

For both options Clint, Gus, Willy, Wizard, and Linus also have "UpdateSprite" versions if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22977]Bara Anthro - Furry Characters[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25073]SFW Bara Anthro - Furry Characters[/url]﻿. Nude option For Clint's updated beach sprites also added as true/false.

Clint, Gus, Willy, Wizard, and Linus also have an "UpdatedPort" option for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24846]Enti's Furry Barafications[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KagamiSora03/mods?gameId=1303]KagamiSora03's Bara Portraits
[/url]
To enable them: Use a text editor to open the "config.json" file in the "Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Looking for Love\[CP] Looking for Love" folder so Linus and/or Willy use "UpdateSprite" instead of "VanillaSprite" and for Willy "UpdatePort" instead of "VanillaPort" (see pictures for example). Or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to select their 'Updated' sprites and deselect their 'Vanilla' sprites options.
